Ladakh authorities promise Article 371 framework for constitutional safeguards

Two days before the first anniversary of four deaths in alleged police firing on protesters in Leh, Ladakh authorities announced on Tuesday that they are working on a new constitutional safeguard framework under Article 371. The protesters had been demanding Sixth Schedule status and statehood for Ladakh on September 24 last year. The Chief Secretary stated that the administration is developing this framework.
